findings.highlight: Tohsaka glares at me as if I'm a challenge to surmount.
findings.evidenceJa: 挑むような態度で、遠坂は睨んできた。
findings.governingReading: She glares with a confrontational, challenging attitude after realizing he lacks awareness.
findings.explanation: Rin’s challenging glare becomes treating Shirou as a challenge she must surmount.

findings.highlight: if you think Strengthening is an extension of Projection.
findings.evidenceJa: 強化の延長で投影をしようなんていう貴方
findings.governingReading: Rin calls Shirou’s method nonsense because he skips both full and abbreviated procedures and attempts Projection by extending his Strengthening process.
findings.explanation: Projection as an extension of Strengthening is reversed into Strengthening as an extension of Projection.

findings.highlight: if you change your process a bit.
findings.evidenceJa: 少し手順を変えてあげるだけで
findings.governingReading: Rin considers that she may be able to make him immediately useful by changing the Projection procedure for him a little.
findings.explanation: Rin offering to alter Shirou’s procedure for him becomes Shirou changing it himself.

findings.highlight: you'll be useful right away if you just recreate that!
findings.evidenceJa: 再現できれば即戦力じゃないっ！
findings.governingReading: Rin says that if he can reproduce Archer’s swords, that capability will constitute immediately deployable fighting strength.
findings.explanation: Projection becoming an immediate combat asset becomes Shirou himself becoming useful.

findings.highlight: whether on purpose or not, it means you're capable of doing it at will!
findings.evidenceJa: 出来た以上は偶然だろうが必然だろうがモノにしなさい！
findings.governingReading: Whether yesterday’s success was accident or necessity, Rin orders Shirou to make it his own now that he has once accomplished it.
findings.explanation: Rin’s command to master an achieved result becomes a claim that any success proves reproduction at will.

findings.highlight: it gets my gall that Tohsaka says so.
findings.evidenceJa: 遠坂にそう言われるとカチンとくる。
findings.governingReading: He knows he is half-trained, but hearing Rin say so still irritates him.
findings.explanation: Shirou says Rin’s remark irritates him. “Gets my gall” mixes English expressions for irritation without producing the intended idiom.

findings.highlight: It's getting to the point where girls shouldn't be out and about alone.
findings.evidenceJa: 女の子が夜出歩く時間じゃない
findings.governingReading: He states his protective, old-fashioned judgment without an “alone” condition, then privately treats outdoors after nine as effectively late night for a girl.
findings.explanation: Shirou’s categorical view that nine is no hour for a girl to be out becomes a narrower rule about being out alone.
